headline: Public hearings on merging lots and building a new 32-unit apartment building at 10-12 and 14 Amherst Street.
summary: The Commission will hold two public hearings on a proposal by Harbor Homes Inc. to merge lots at 10-12 and 14 Amherst Street, demolish existing buildings, and build a new 32-unit, 3-story apartment building. The meeting will also include a discussion item on the Lock and Whitney St Pedestrian & Bicycle Improvements.
items: Public hearing: Harbor Homes Inc. (Henry Och, President and CEO), applicants Jonathon Halle & Warren Street Architects, Inc., for 10-12 Amherst Street (Sheet 68 Lot 33) - proposed merger of lots at 10-12 and 14 Amherst Street, demolition of existing buildings, and construction of a new 32-unit, 3-story apartment building, within Historic District overlay (HD), Downtown One overlay (D1), and Mixed-Use Overlay (MU), Ward 3

Public hearing: Harbor Homes Inc. (Henry Och, President and CEO), applicants Jonathon Halle & Warren Street Architects, Inc., for 14 Amherst Street (Sheet 68 Lot 35) - proposed merger of lots at 10-12 and 14 Amherst Street, demolition of existing buildings, and construction of a new 32-unit, 3-story apartment building, within Historic District overlay (HD), Downtown One Overlay (D1), and Mixed-Use Overlay (MU), Ward 3
Discussion item: Lock and Whitney St Pedestrian & Bicycle Improvements (CMA Engineers)
location: Room 208, Nashua City Hall, 229 Main Street, Nashua, NH

2026, and read into the record at the appropriate time. Letters 
should be addressed to City of Nashua, Planning Department, P.O. 
Box 2019, Nashua, NH 03061. Plans can be viewed online starting 
October 21, 2026 at www.nashuanh.gov.
